head: 2c44fed54309e20d19105c69276c05f4113a524a
scope: Improve local code-search relevance and make repository ignore policy consistent across indexing, incremental refresh, filesystem watching, freshness checks, and exact code projection. Honor root .gitignore, .dockerignore, and .git/info/exclude with conservative generated/secret defaults while preserving useful source/config files.
non_goals: Do not implement semantic embeddings or a full language-model reranker.
Do not ignore all dotfiles; retain useful repository configuration such as .github and tool configs unless repository rules exclude them.
Do not change hosted/company retrieval behavior.
risks: Ignore-pattern semantics can accidentally hide useful source if negation or rooted patterns are mishandled.
Changing ranking may alter established search ordering.
Large repositories may spend time reading multiple ignore files unless matcher loading remains per crawl.
